name: pr-review-ui
description: PR reviews as numbered points in the conversation; picking a point opens its code beside it: in your editor when Claude Code runs in a VS Code or JetBrains terminal, in terminal-browser in Ghostty or kitty, or in a code pane.

codeView.title: Where review code shows
codeView.description: auto follows your terminal: the editor in a VS Code or JetBrains terminal, terminal-browser (the GitHub page, lines highlighted) in Ghostty or kitty when it is installed, and the code pane everywhere else, including the desktop app. ide, browser and pane pick one always.

ideCommand.title: Editor command
ideCommand.description: The command that opens a file at a line, such as code, cursor, idea or goland. Leave empty to find VS Code or the JetBrains IDE you run Claude Code in.

ghPath.title: gh executable
ghPath.description: The GitHub CLI the review uses to read the PR diff. Use a full path if gh is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.

autoReview.title: Review when you paste a PR link
autoReview.description: When a prompt says review and holds a GitHub PR link, ask for the review in the points format without needing the slash command.
